rationale: The agent looked up the user and orders but then executed a return on four items and refunded to a gift card without any prior confirmation. The user requested returning only the more expensive tablet with refund to credit card; there is no evidence the agent identified the correct tablet, attempted a credit card refund, explained why a credit refund wasn’t possible, or obtained user approval before performing a write. It also failed to provide a correct final summary of what was done. These actions violate the policy requirements to confirm before order-changing writes and to fulfill the specific request accurately.
